title: Mozart's Life In Reverse, From Vienna Back to Salzburg #Shorts
description:
Mozart's life runs backwards, from his death in Vienna in 1791 to his baptism in Salzburg in 1756. The five steps pass the funeral mass he left unfinished, the opera of September 1791, the loan letters he wrote as a grown man and the first dances his father set down when he was five. Dates follow the documented record.

Made with AI assistance.

#Mozart #Biography #LifeInReverse #Shorts #ClassicalMusic #Composers #Documentary

scenes.narration: A composer who died at thirty-five in 1791 was buried the next day in Vienna in a grave the city expected to reuse, and the exact place is still not known.
Step backwards and he is in bed that November finishing a funeral mass that a nobleman wanted for his wife, with his pupil waiting for the pages.
Further back a theatre in the suburbs fills on September 30, 1791, for a comic play about a magic flute and the man who sells a bird catcher's pipes.
Before that he is a grown man writing to fellow masons for loans, teaching in the mornings and playing benefits while the household falls behind.
At the start there is a child in 1756 in Salzburg who writes minuets at five and has a violinist father who dates them as he copies them out.
